title: plugin.yaml, the manifest of a plugin bundle: read before any code loads, shown at approval, strict

contract.description: the plugin contract; the engine speaks exactly one

needs.description: features beyond the base; contract 1 starts with none. An engine without one refuses the plugin at open (ErrFeature)

version.description: the plugin's own version, its folder below the name

tool_versions.description: the tool versions served: one comparator, or a lower and an upper bound. It judges the grant whose id is tool, and no other; the opener refuses a manifest with no such grant

provides.description: at least one; an op outside it is answered unsupported (C15)

extends.description: false: the preset is copied once

warning.description: false: the tool has no warning level

path.description: the preset file, where the engine writes what preset returns. Held to the adapter format's relative: slash-separated, no leading slash, no drive, no backslash, no step that is . or .., and only letters, digits, ., _, - and /.

inputs.description: the files handed to preset as inputs, each held to the adapter format's relative

mark.description: true: the mark stands in the first line of every preset file

at.description: where the project's config names the config it extends: a JSON pointer, a plain lookup with no expression's character and no control character

install.description: the tool's own documented install, literal words; the engine prints it and never runs it

wiring.description: how a project wires a preset in; absent where the tool needs neither an import nor an install

resolve_from.description: the folder, relative to the config set, that a run links into the scratch folder so the tool resolves what the config imports. A folder of the project the tool then loads code from: a trust input of its own, shown at approval Held to the adapter format's relative: slash-separated, no leading slash, no drive, no backslash, no step that is . or .., and only letters, digits, ., _, - and /.

programs.description: the grants: every program the plugin may ever ask the engine to run. No two alike; an id given twice is the opener's to refuse, since a screen that shows the first and a run that takes the last is the hole

oneOf.description: a program found in the settings and the machine tools file alone: the pinned places, the safest form

path.description: one place the program is looked for, below the project, with no system's suffix (host adds it); a pinned find never takes it. Held to the adapter format's relative: slash-separated, no leading slash, no drive, no backslash, no step that is . or .., and only letters, digits, ., _, - and /.

oneOf.description: a program also looked for at one place below the project

manifest.description: an interpreted script: the package manifest that names it, relative to the project and never under a .bin folder (the opener holds the folder). Held to the adapter format's relative: slash-separated, no leading slash, no drive, no backslash, no step that is . or .., and only letters, digits, ., _, - and /.

script_at.description: an interpreted script: the JSON pointer of its path in that manifest. The value there is a string, relative to the manifest's folder, and stays inside it by its spelling and through links; the schema cannot see that value, so the opener holds it. A JSON pointer, a plain lookup with no expression's character and no control character.

interpreter.description: an interpreted script: the program that runs it; the engine puts the script first

oneOf.description: an interpreted script a package manifest names, run by its interpreter with the script first; all three fields together

items.description: one grant: one of three forms, a variant; at most one of path and the script fields, and the script fields all three or none

shown.description: text a person reads or a path names: no control (Cc: C0 and C1, U+009B, the one-character CSI, among them), no format character (Cf: the bidirectional overrides and isolates, U+200B, U+FEFF and the rest), and no line or paragraph separator (Zl, Zp), so what a screen prints is what the field holds. The class is defined by the Unicode categories, not a list of ranges, so a format character a list misses is refused too

grantId.description: the grant's id, which a run step names as its program

versions.description: the versions of this program the plugin serves, as name@version is looked up in the settings and the tools file; for the grant whose id is tool, the manifest's tool_versions judges it

versionArgv.description: the argv after which the program prints its version

versionPattern.description: where the version stands in what it prints, as a pattern with one group in RE2, Go's regexp dialect, so it is linear in the capped output and a look-ahead is refused at open; absent, the first major.minor.patch No control character; whether it compiles and has one group is the opener's.

ascii.description: printable ASCII alone (U+0020 to U+007E), for a field that is neither a path nor text a person reads: a pointer into a package manifest or a config, and an RE2 pattern; so no look-alike letter, filler or invisible character can stand in one
